name: ✦ ELITE REBORN ✦
description:
We are a minecraft medieval roleplay server with a friendly and fast growing community.

Mostly we focus on survival but we also have SkyBlock and Minigames.

We are trieng to bring our players a unique and different Minecraft experience by providing more freedom, permissions and many different plugins that enhances the gameplay even more.

We have great staff (no admin will ban or troll you).
